metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the LAS 1.4 JSON inspect/render tool.

Files:
- [output/main.cpp](/workspace/output/main.cpp)
- [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py)
- [output/CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/output/CMakeLists.txt)
- [CMakeLists.txt](/workspace/CMakeLists.txt) build shim so `cmake -B build && cmake --build build` works from `/workspace`

Verified:
- `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`
- render of the sample-style format 6 dataset
- inspect of the rendered LAS
- inspect/render byte-for-byte round trip
- invalid render dataset returns `invalid_request` as required
